<!-- pr-reviewer: 5d2d12863309496ae90173a44460d8fb7cc06dcb -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One item: the slack tolerance is not pinned. The geometry is sound and the wiring is right.

### What looks good
- **The capsule test is exact, not sampled.** `refuse_unfit_slot` requires both endpoints inside the region (`Region::contains`, an even-odd test over all loops, so an endpoint in a hole is out). It then takes the exact segment-to-segment distance from A-B to every edge of every loop: a proper crossing gives 0, and otherwise it takes the min of the four endpoint-to-segment feet. For a single straight centre line, "both ends inside and every edge at least w/2 from the segment" is exactly "the capsule lies inside the region". That holds for concave outlines and for holes or islands too. A hole lying wholly inside the band is caught by distance even when the centre line misses it. Nothing pokes out between samples, because nothing is sampled.
- **It tests what the tool sweeps.** The motion side keeps the cutter centre within `room = W/2 - r - stock_to_leave` of the centre line (`trochoid_loops::contained`; the bore helix has radius `b <= room` about `c0`). The swept envelope is therefore at most `W/2 - stock_to_leave` from the segment. Testing the region against `W/2` covers the full slot width, loops and helix included, and is conservative by the stock to leave. The 1-degree arc sampling in `contained` plus its 1e-6 allowance adds well under 1 µm.
- **Slack direction.** `d + 1e-4 < half` lets the envelope reach at most 1e-4 mm (0.1 µm) past the selection edge. That is below machine resolution, and it is what lets an exactly-as-wide slot fit. Acceptable.
- **Degenerate input.** A non-finite or non-positive width and an empty region are refused by name. Non-finite A/B and width <= 0 are already refused at the parameter door (`types/sane.rs:757-762`). With a == b the helper tests a disc, which is correct, and the generator then refuses it ("two distinct, finite points").
- **Area controls cannot loosen the region.** `area_unsupported` refuses non-default controls for TrochoidalSlot, so the region is the raw `Region::new(loops)` of the picks.
- **No selection.** The behaviour is unchanged, and the post's stock-sim gouge clause decides. `the_post_refuses_an_unconfined_trochoid_that_enters_the_model` pins that, and blinding `posting_sim.rs:73` turns it red (I confirmed this). The posting code is untouched by this diff, so a stale cached path, whether from before the fix or loaded from a project, still meets the same gouge clause at the post.
- **Wiring.** The region is now resolved before generation, and the refusal comes before `trochoidal_slot` runs. A refused slot caches nothing (pinned).
- **Housekeeping.** `slot_fit.rs` is 160 lines with a provenance line. There is no `unwrap`/`expect` outside tests, and the `pts[(i + 1) % pts.len()]` index is safe inside the iteration. The decision file `docs/decisions/1503-trochoid-confine.md` records what happens to the stand-alone op. A `Changelog:` line is present, and the commit subjects are conventional. Nothing touches `CHANGELOG.md`, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, snapshots or goldens.

### Local results (trial merge with upstream/main, clean, no conflicts; macOS, debug)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --lib` (incl. `slot_fit::tests`, 2) | 186 passed |
| app `trochoid_confine` | 4 passed |
| app `trochoid_op` | 5 passed |
| app `operations` | 119 passed, 6 ignored |
| app `posting` | 17 passed |
| app `mcp` / `mcp_order` | 22 / 3 passed |
| app `slot_caps` / `stock_sim_document` / `pocket_overhead` | 4 / 9 / 2 passed |
| app `area_controls` / `project_roundtrip` | 13 / 73 passed |
| motion `trochoid_slot` | 10 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

I did not run the ui suites. No ui code changed, and they open windows.

### Mutation checks (each applied alone, then restored)
| Mutation | Red pins |
|---|---|
| Call skipped in `generate.rs` (`if false && ...`) | `a_slot_longer...`, `mcp_refuses...` |
| Comparison flipped (`d + FIT_TOL > half`) | both unit tests, 3 of 4 integration tests |
| Hole loops skipped (`loops.iter().take(1)`) | `an_endpoint_outside_or_a_centre_line_across_a_hole...` |
| Endpoint-inside check removed | `an_endpoint_outside...` |
| Crossing never detected | `an_endpoint_outside...` |
| Half-width replaced by the cutter-centre band (`half - 3`) | both unit tests, `a_slot_longer...`, `mcp_refuses...` |
| Endpoint-to-edge feet dropped | `a_slot_inside_fits...`, `a_slot_longer...`, `mcp_refuses...` |
| Slack made stricter (`d - FIT_TOL`) | `a_slot_inside_fits...` (the exactly-as-wide case) |
| Post gouge clause blinded (`posting_sim.rs:73`) | `the_post_refuses_an_unconfined_trochoid...` |
| **Slack loosened `FIT_TOL = 1e-4` -> `0.5`** | **none: all 6 green** |
| **Slack loosened `FIT_TOL = 1e-4` -> `1.0`** | **none: all 6 green** |

### Requested before merge
1. **Pin the slack.** In `crates/app/src/operation/slot_fit.rs:20`, `FIT_TOL` can be raised to 1 mm, and in fact to just under 2 mm, with every pin still green. The smallest overrun any test refuses is 2 mm (the hole case) or 3 mm (the end-wall case). A slot that cuts 1 mm into the model past its selection would therefore pass the suite, so the "refused, never across a wall" claim is not pinned at the tolerance it states. Please add a near-miss pin to `slot_fit::tests`. For example, in the same `rect(25.0, 12.5)` pocket:
   - A (-12.5, 0) to B (12.51, 0) at width 25 (0.01 mm past the end wall) is refused.
   - A (-12.5, 0) to B (12.5, 0) at width 25.02 (0.01 mm too wide) is refused.
   Keep the existing exactly-as-wide case beside it, so the tolerance is held from both sides. Any overrun of about 1e-3 mm or more, well above `FIT_TOL` and well below anything a loosening could hide, will do.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 3416 lines, far over the ~400-line guide. This PR adds 6 net lines there, which is fine, but the file is due a split.
- Edge-chain picks and the side walls are not pinned at integration level, only the face pick and the end walls. The helper treats every edge alike, so the unit tests cover the geometry. One integration pin with an edge-chain pick would close the "Not exercised" item cheaply.
- An offset or tilted setup is not exercised. `a`/`b` and the picked region appear to be in the same setup-local frame (the 5.000 mm figure matches at the origin), but a pin with a non-zero WCS offset would make that explicit.
- `Refs #1503`: what stays open is item 2 (the Adaptive trochoidal method, #1509) and its UI/undo/MCP coverage, all of it feature work. The safety part of #1503, Expected 1, is fully addressed here: a selection is refused at generate, and without one the post refuses. Shipping this part now is right for a P1. The maintainer can close #1503 at merge, with #1509 carrying the rest.
- #1509 is labelled `P2`. By the AGENTS.md table, P2 means main is broken or a regression, but #1509 is new feature work. P4 (asked for by the maintainer) looks like the right number. That is the maintainer's call; I have not changed it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
